Class ClientCraftingOptionSlotsTooltip

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.tooltip.ClientCraftingOptionSlotsTooltip
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.tooltip.ClientTooltipComponent
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClientCraftingOptionIngredientsTooltip, ClientCraftingOptionMachinesTooltip
public abstract class ClientCraftingOptionSlotsTooltip extends Object implements net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.tooltip.ClientTooltipComponent
Base class for tooltip components that render a grid of slots. The grid wraps after MAX_COLUMNS slots, and is spread evenly over as few rows as possible.
